text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Teio Sho. The premier race to crown 
the dirt champion of the first half of the 
year. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's enthusiasm isn't really 
picking up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By refusing to give up and trying various 
therapies, my muscle flexibility has 
largely recovered. Yet, the tension and 
spark in my heart remain lost.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Ah, Oi Racecourse brings back 
memories...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? You know, that Japan Dirt 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My very first GⅠ at Ohi. The dirt was so 
tough to run on, man, it really took me by 
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
“Back then, though, Trainer and I 
finally... gained confidence in our bond 
together, didn't we?”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I was just... so, so happy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Memories racing. The past overflowing. 
Even so—
choice_data_list:
Let's get even more used to it! It's a 
course you'll run many times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The excitement in the venue had reached 
its peak. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Conversely, there were also things that 
sank below. Quietly, without anyone 
knowing."
